short_blurb: Remodels, additions & ADUs — licensed general contractor in Torrance.
local_note: Torrance homeowners choose Palm Crest Builders for kitchen and bath remodels, room additions, ADUs, and whole-home renovations. We know the local building department, design for Torrance's mix of housing styles, and manage design, permits, and construction with our own licensed crews. We build throughout Torrance, including Old Torrance, Hollywood Riviera, Walteria, and nearby neighborhoods. Every project is built to the California Building Code and backed by our workmanship warranty.

faqs.q: Do you pull building permits in Torrance?
faqs.a: Yes — we handle plans, plan check, and permits through the Torrance building and safety department for every remodel, addition, and ADU, and we schedule all required inspections.

faqs.q: Can I build an ADU in Torrance?
faqs.a: In most cases, yes. Under California and Torrance rules, most single-family lots qualify for a detached, attached, or garage-conversion ADU. We handle feasibility, design, permits, and construction.

faqs.q: How long will my Torrance remodel or addition take?
faqs.a: It depends on scope — bathrooms typically run 3–5 weeks, kitchens 4–8 weeks, and room additions 2–4 months. We give you a firm schedule with milestones in your written estimate.
